title: Follow the Fish
staging:
Scene 19 — Follow the Fish

16:35–17:10 · 35 sec · Hacking lair

Neon discovers that Goodboy Global's salmon shipments are being diverted away from Districts 7–12 and toward wealthy Districts 1–6. The alleged shortage is actually a distribution restriction.

Shots: Shipping database → district map → redirection arrows → close-up of salmon shipment records.
